title: Application identity across a trust boundary
subtitle: A caller obtains an audience-bound token; the callee verifies it before authorization.

nodes.title: App A · OIDCClient
lines: Token is addressed to App B

notes: External issuers can include Kubernetes service accounts, GitHub Actions, and GCP metadata.
Verifier fetches and caches trusted issuer discovery / JWKS; discovery itself does not grant trust.
alt: App A obtains an audience-bound token from its issuer or an external issuer. App B resolves the Bearer token, verifies it with trusted issuer keys, creates a stateless application session, and checks IAM permissions.
caption: A caller obtains an audience-bound token; the callee verifies it before authorization.

title: From bearer token to an authorization decision
subtitle: A successful OIDC request creates a stateless application session.

Issuer selection alone is not authentication: signature and claim verification must succeed.
